_finding: The recorder may keep short-lived private copies of DexScreener and GeckoTerminal answers in /var/lib/stp-raw (scripts/stocks/raw-store.mjs). They are not the site's: no route may serve them and the web app may not name them. These mutations give the site a path to them.

mutations.name: a route serves the private copies
mutations.find: if (STATIC[sub]) { const s = static_[sub]; return send(res, 200, s.body, s.type, { 'cache-control': 'public, max-age=86400' }) }
mutations.replace:
if (sub.startsWith('/stp-raw/')) { try { return send(res, 200, fs.readFileSync(path.join(path.dirname(roots.base), sub)), 'application/octet-stream', {}) } catch (_) {} }
    if (STATIC[sub]) { const s = static_[sub]; return send(res, 200, s.body, s.type, { 'cache-control': 'public, max-age=86400' }) }
mutations.expect: FAIL no route serves a byte of the private copies, whatever the path

mutations.name: the web app imports the store
mutations.expect: FAIL the web app has no code path to them: no file in apps/ names the store, its module or its switch
